title: Exact robust gaps in finite open chiral chains
summary: Exact worst squared spectral gaps for finite open chiral chains with inhomogeneous strong-bond lower bounds and weak-bond ratio intervals. The scalar optimum is the minimum over the ordered one-switch endpoint configurations, with a two-certificate reduction when cuts are allowed. Strictly positive weak lower bounds give a complete point-or-edge classification of scalar minimizers and an exact aligned-channel equality criterion for arbitrary complex matrix disorder. The sharp channel bound includes the finite chiral Hamiltonian spectral bridge.

review.reason: Derives exact worst-case spectral gaps for finite open chiral chains with disorder.
